mathematics.assertion_tested: The documented supplementary checker reproduces every accepted run-007 finite result, verifies the manuscript CLI output and source/output identities, reconstructs 24 Schur packet coefficients, checks 12 complete sampling-kernel rows and 18 Euler index-shift cases with the zero-index negative control. The optional pinned-library comparison is recorded separately.
mathematics.conventions: The primary EULER-CASE-006 contract applies. Full-index E_n and compressed E_(2n) are compared separately. Polynomial matrices act on finite-support coefficient columns.

Pinned Komorebi Math source, N=2..6, n=0..10, integer powers 0..3 plus analytic parameters -2,-1,0,1/2,1,2,3
Prime charts 2,3,5,7 at every even degree 0..20, including source, kernel, inverse kernel, forward and inverse reconstruction, every finite truncation and row weight

Packet values and two state coordinates for all N=1..12, every admitted address, and ten coarse terms; jump powers 1..12 plus 12*2^a for a=0..4; Fibonacci primitive and derivative matrices for source degrees 0..8
C_(4,j) values j=0..3,n=0..23; Hurwitz inverse and product degrees 0..24 at p=3,5,7; both Stirling tables and formal logarithmic coordinate outputs through degree 16
